description.text: Application Deadline The applicants can still apply for degree programs one month after the semester begins.

duration.text: The Chinese Language at Capital Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3277 USD/per year ￥ 23600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Permission from the previous university for tranfer students A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university

requirements.text: Aged under 40 years old Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate HSK level 7 or above
